question: Does the Cloudflare security-audit skill validate candidate findings with a fresh verifier that tries to refute them?

snippets.text: Six-phase audit: candidate validation runs a fresh verifier whose task is to refute each candidate before it can be reported, not to confirm it.
The independent record-verification phase re-verifies with material replacements, so a finding survives only if the fresh check holds.

question: Does the Cloudflare security-audit skill permit contacting deployed endpoints?

snippets.text: Universal execution safety: do not contact deployed endpoints. When a question cannot be decided from the local code, mark the candidate needs_validation instead of probing it.
The skill requires an OS-enforced sandbox: no external network, allowlisted environment, read-only target, scratch-only writes.

question: Does the TypeSafe System One API expose a websearch parameter?

snippets.text: The public docs contain no websearch parameter; the request body is {state, model, questions} and the console orchestrates retrieval client-side: selected evidence goes verbatim into state.search_results.
Primitives table: choice, score, noul — no search primitive is listed; state is caller-supplied.

question: Does the browser-use/jev-ultrafast demo depend on browser-harness?

snippets.text: pyproject.toml dependencies: browser-harness==0.1.13 and httpx[http2]; the agent loop executes over raw CDP through browser-harness.
README: an interactive browser agent loop — snapshot.js builds an indexed element table, model.choose() sends one TypeSafe request, agent.py executes via browser.py over raw CDP (browser_harness).

question: Does the jev-ultrafast demo send one TypeSafe request per step using speculative fan-out (an operation Choice plus target Choices over the same state)?

snippets.text: model.choose() sends one TypeSafe request with speculative fan-out: an operation Choice plus one *_target Choice per operation, all evaluated against the same state.
Strict response validation on the fan-out: the probability simplex must be ≈1 and the picked choice must be the argmax (validate_choice).
